name: b2b-ai-chatbot-monorepo
description: Multi-tenant B2B AI Chatbot SaaS Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@b2b-ai-chatbot/widget && node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>fs.copyFileSync('dorafi/widget/dist/widget.iife.js','dorafi/admin/public/widget.iife.js'))" && npm run build --workspace=@b2b-ai-chatbot/admin
scripts.test: node scripts/tests/test-contracts.js && node scripts/tests/test-billing-mapping.js && node scripts/tests/test-widget-status.js && node scripts/tests/test-brand-color.js && node scripts/tests/test-db-retry.js && node scripts/tests/test-migrations.js && node scripts/tests/test-schemas.js && node scripts/tests/test-api-imports.cjs && node scripts/tests/test-email-delivery.js
